conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Are there any other significant challenges that come to mind?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Another significant challenge is power consumption, as these massive data centers require enormous amounts of energy to operate and cool their systems. Environmental concerns related to this energy use are also increasingly important.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
